text_block_list.text:
As I pass by the dance studio, I'm
surprised to
hear Уиннинг Тикит's voice
from inside.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yo! Hah! YAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ticket, how many times must I say that
you waste
too much effort with your
moves?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You don't always have to use "full
power." Try to
pace yourself a little.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Hey, what are you guys doing?

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello. I'd normally say it should be
obvious,
but perhaps that's not the case.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
When I first saw her engaged in this
activity, I
thought she was practicing
karate chops.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Huh?! What do you mean? I'm clearly doing dance moves!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Her words, not mine.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I got some advice from Hayahide, but
it's not
really going so well.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Especially the final twirl! No matter how
much I
try, I always lose my balance!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, oh, Trainer! You gotta have some
advice for
me too, right?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Well, I'm not a dance instructor, so...

text_block_list.text: Actually, your insight may be valuable precisely because this isn't your area of expertise.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If this goes on, I'm gonna make a fool of
myself at
the winning concert for sure!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Come ooon! Please! I need your help!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You need to amp yourself up more.

text_block_list.text: Come ooon! Please! I need your help!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You need to amp yourself up more.

text_block_list.text:
Amp myself up? Riiight, that's gotta be
it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: First I'll get motivated... YAAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: ALL RIGHT! LET'S GOOO!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Instead of reason, you go with

motivation? You two are well matched.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I suspect you may understand Ticket
more
thoroughly than I do.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We match well? Like, we make a good
pair?
W-wow!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm kinda embarrassed! But that makes
me happy
too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Okay, one more time! Watch me closely,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Really? That's weird, I thought I was
using the
right amount...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I told you it was too much. That's why
your
movement isn't clean.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
At the very least, there's no need to give
those
deafening yells with every move
you make.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, okay! You both have some good
advice. I'll
give it another go!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Still a little too strong, I think.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Even less than that?! Okay, okay...
Relax... relax...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wobble... Aaaah...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
Wh-why'd you slump onto the floor? Are you
okay?

text_block_list.text: Huh? I just tried to relax my entire body.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Now you're not using enough power.
How do you
plan to dance like this?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right! Wow, Hayahide, you're
so smart!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You must have studied so much... sniffle... to become that smart!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Waaaah! Hayahide! You're great!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, I understand... Let's continue
your
dance lesson.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sob... Okaaay!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ticket fires herself up even more and
manages to
nail the final twirl
beautifully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After a thorough lesson on the value of
relaxing
her muscles, Уиннинг Тикит
ends up a little
better prepared for her
future dancing endeavors.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
